name: How long does a typical trim replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical trim replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a trim replacement project varies significantly based on the scope. Replacing trim in a single room, such as baseboards or around one window, might take a day or two. A whole-house trim replacement project, involving multiple rooms and various types of trim (e.g., baseboards, crown molding, door and window casings), could extend from several days to a week or more. Factors like existing trim removal complexity, material choice, and finishing (painting/staining) also influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim replacement time varies by project size, from a day for a single room to over a week for an entire house. Scope, material, and finishing impact the schedule.
